messages:
tara_docs: Opening a small PR to add a Dedicated provisioning "micro-guide" focused on migration UX and a tiny Rust SDK example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1502

leo_sdk: Love the micro-guide idea. Can you include a minimal Rust snippet? A lot of infra teams here are using Rust now.

anya_infra: Also please add a one-line CLI migration example and a short checklist: dry-run, capacity-check, maintenance-window, smoke-test.

tara_docs: Draft checklist (will put in PR):
- dry-run migration (--dry-run)
- confirm reserved_pool_capacity >= expected_qps
- maintenance window + notif
- post-migration smoke test (ping endpoint + latency check)

sam_policy: SLA wording: don't promise "no preemption". Suggest: "Reserved pools are prioritized for availability; preemption may occur only under defined capacity emergencies per SLA." I'll paste a suggested sentence into the PR.

leo_sdk: Rust snippet (tiny draft):
```rust
use redwood_sdk::DedicatedClient;
async fn create_pool() {
  let c = DedicatedClient::new();
  c.create_pool("rust-pool", "a100-40gb", 1, 3).await.unwrap();
}
```

anya_infra: CLI example: `redwoodctl tenant migrate --from legacy-team --to-pool rust-pool --dry-run` (recommend dry-run first).

tara_docs: YAML quick sample for the micro-guide:
```yaml
name: rust-pool
gpu: a100-40gb
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 3
  burst: 1
tenant_isolation: true
```

leo_sdk: Tiny note: in docs prefer `tenant_isolation` (snake_case) to match REST. Also add a one-line note that `min_replicas` is advisory under extreme hardware pressure.

ci-bot: docs-lint: passed for PR #1502 

tara_docs: Good catches  I'll update wording to avoid absolute isolation claims and include Sam's SLA sentence. Question: include a brief "cost hint" (single line) or keep it out?

sam_policy: One-line cost hint OK if clearly labelled "rough estimate" and links to pricing.

anya_infra: Add troubleshooting bullet: "NodeAffinity errors occur when requested SKU isn't available in region; check pool describe before migrating."

tara_docs: Will fold all changes and ping reviewers @leo_sdk @anya_infra. Target merge: next Wed EOD if no blockers.
